title: AkatZumaFixStack
description: Fixed an issue where using vanilla containers (chests, hoppers, etc.) to consume items while the Bigger Stacks mod was installed on Arclight would cause the quantity to reset to 64
body:
Fixed an issue where using vanilla containers (chests, hoppers, etc.) to consume items while the [Bigger Stacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/biggerstacks) mod was installed on [Arclight](https://github.com/IzzelAliz/Arclight) would cause the quantity to reset to 64.

* Installation is required only on the server; no installation is needed on the client side.

* If any original containers are missing, please leave a comment below.



修复 [Arclight](https://github.com/IzzelAliz/Arclight) 上安装 [Bigger Stacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/biggerstacks) 模组在使用原版容器（箱子、漏斗等）吞物品变成 64 的问题。

* 只在服务端安装即可，客户端无需安装；

* 如有遗漏的原版容器，请在评论区留言。
